slices.title: Remove tracked target build artifacts and binaries
slices.jtbd: When implementing the repository cleanup for this epic, I want to remove untracked build artifacts and binaries from version control, so that the repository contains only valid source and config files.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a repository containing build artifacts, When the cleanup is executed, Then the diff contains only source, config, test, or documentation files needed for this slice.
Given the binary file data/docs/uploads/protocol_2024.pdf is tracked, When it is removed, Then it is no longer in version control.
Given the build output tree under target/classes/ is tracked, When it is removed, Then it is no longer in version control.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of incorrectly tracked files from >10 to 0.
